entities.summary: Antonina Zetova is a former international volleyball player from Bulgaria. She is the head coach of the Bulgaria women's national volleyball team and also coached the U18 and U23 women's national teams. Antonina Zetova was a athletes & competitors from Pleven (b. 1973-09-07, Pleven). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
